verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents a built-in agent that explores segments and analyzes campaign performance in natural language inside the product. Its AI Decisioning feature uses reinforcement learning to recommend the best message, channel, and timing per customer and measures what worked, which directly covers in-product AI insights and suggestions. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on the built-in agent's insight and suggestion behavior (it gets only a single line), proactive or unprompted insight surfacing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
